description: Address security and quality issues from code review: XSS in unsubscribe, unauthenticated weekly email, rate limiting, timer manipulation, service worker 404s, duplicate SM-2 comment, import validation
steps: Fix unsubscribe XSS: validate token as UUID format and use JSON.stringify for safe embedding
Fix weekly email endpoint: reject when CRON_SECRET is not configured (fail-closed)
Add in-memory rate limiter to /api/explain (per-IP, 10 requests/minute)
Fix mock exam timer: compute remaining time from startedAt + timeLimitSeconds
Fix service worker: only precache '/' and let dynamic routes cache on first navigation
Add comment to spaced-repetition/utils/scheduler.ts noting intentional duplication
Add basic type validation to data portability importer
Run full verification: lint, tsc, build, test
acceptance_criteria: Unsubscribe endpoint rejects non-UUID tokens and safely embeds valid ones
Weekly email endpoint returns 401 when CRON_SECRET is not set
/api/explain returns 429 after 10 requests per minute per IP
Mock exam timer is computed from startedAt + timeLimitSeconds, not stored value
Service worker only precaches '/' at install time
SM-2 scheduler has comment explaining intentional isolation
Import validates array/object types before writing to localStorage
All tests pass, lint clean, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
